# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We are committed to providing a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone involved with this project.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good intent.
- Focus feedback on code, design, and behavior, not on people.
- Be patient with maintainers and contributors.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or hateful language.
- Personal attacks, trolling, or insults.
- Doxxing, threats, or any abusive conduct.
- Repeatedly ignoring project rules or moderator guidance.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove content, close issues or pull requests, and restrict participation when behavior violates this code of conduct.

## Reporting

If you need to report a problem, open a private contact through the repository owner or use the email listed in the project metadata if available.
